input.answer: StatCan's quarterly estimate puts Canada's population at 41,798,407 on July 1, 2026 (about 41.8 million). That is 80,343 (+0.2%) above the April 1, 2026 estimate of 41,718,064. Arithmetic: 41,798,407 − 41,718,064 = 80,343; 80,343 / 41,718,064 ≈ 0.19%, rounded to 0.2%.

answer_values.label: change_pct
answer_values.description: Percent change from April 1 to July 1, 2026
